warnings.headline: Heavy rain may bring transport disruption and some flooding in places
warnings.description:
Spells of persistent and heavy rain will develop from the early hours of Monday and continue through the rest of the day, overnight and into Tuesday morning. The rain will be accompanied by strong to gale force south to southwesterly winds. 

While there is some uncertainty over amounts of rain, 30-50mm is expected quite widely across the warning area, with some of the wettest spots in the West Highlands and Dumfries and Galloway possibly picking up 70-90mm. In addition, snowmelt over the Highlands will add to river flows in some areas, while saturated ground and leaf debris will hamper drainage and exacerbate surface water flooding on some roads.

For further details see https://www.metoffi
warnings.instruction:
Check if your property could be at risk of flooding. If so, consider preparing a flood plan and an emergency flood kit.

Give yourself the best chance of avoiding delays by checking road conditions if driving, or bus and train timetables, amending your travel plans if necessary.

People cope better with power cuts when they have prepared for them in advance. It's easy to do; consider gathering tor
areas: Central, Tayside & Fife | Grampian | Highlands & Eilean Siar | North West England | Strathclyde | SW Scotland, Lothian Borders
